big_case.notes: Emergency application to the Circuit Justice to force a statewide proof-of-citizenship constitutional amendment (700k+ signatures) onto Michigan's November 2026 ballot after a 2-2 canvassers deadlock. Politically salient nationally and consequential for one state's ballot, but the federal hook is a due-process/equal-protection gloss on a state signature-sampling dispute with no final state-court judgment; disposed by a one-line single-Justice denial, unreferred, no noted dissent, no opinion. High public interest, minimal doctrinal footprint.
